content_zh:
猛地坐起身，她警惕的扫了眼四周。
发现没有什么人和猛兽，这才稍稍松了口气。
摁亮了大灯，整个房间明亮起来。
这是一间极有军人风格的房间。
墨绿色的迷彩地毯，木制大床灰绿色床单，正前方是一张办公台，墙壁上挂满了军事指挥图。
房间很宽敞，截然不同的两种装修风格。
一边办公一边休息，却又互不干扰，独立成两个空间。
她没由来的想起了那个从直升飞机上下来的男人。
虽然没看清楚他长什么样，那凌人的气势，估摸着应该是个军人。
别开头，她低头看了眼自己身上被穿成裙子的男士T恤。
手臂肩膀和腿上的划伤上了药缠着一层纱布，看着像个木乃伊，有些滑稽。
推开门下楼。
刚走到楼梯口就听到楼下传来传来“哗啦”一声玻璃碎裂的声音。
“滚出去！”男人低沉冷冽的嗓音打破客厅的宁静。
站在楼梯上，云曦看了眼客厅里一男一女两道身影。
落地窗边被对着自己的男人，一身迷彩服，军靴往上是修长的长腿颀长倨傲的身姿。
即便他背对着她，云曦也能感觉到他此刻散发出的强大气场。
“少帅，求求你不要赶我走，这么晚已经没有回程的车了，我一个女孩子害怕……”
韩婉灵刚伸手碰到他结实有力的手臂，慕非池猛地一扫，军人的力道直接把韩婉灵甩到了地板上。
“啊……”措不及防摔到地上，韩婉灵一双手直接摁在了地板上的玻璃碎片上，疼得她直哆嗦。

慕非池转过身，嫌恶的蹙起眉。
修长的手解开被碰过的迷彩服外套，兜头砸在了韩婉灵头上。
身上没由来的有一股燥热涌了上来。
他垂眸瞥见地板上摔得狼狈，还不忘扭着腰身叉着腿装委屈的女人。
火红的齐b短裙这么一摔直接撩了起来，露出了里边的黑色蕾丝小裤。
慕非池幽深的眸低涌动着深不可测的黑暗，只是扫了那么一眼，韩婉灵便觉得如受锋芒。
仿佛被一只无形的手扼住了自己的咽喉，只觉得窒息压抑，哪里还记得要趁机勾引他。
云曦这会儿算是看明白怎么回事了。
转身刚要往回走，细微的声响惊动了客厅里敏锐的男人。
“站住！”
云曦一僵，刚踏上楼的脚生生收了回来。
“下来！”
云曦转身，在慕非池慑人的眸光里乖乖走了下来。
韩婉灵似乎没想到屋里还有人，转头打量了眼。
这个不知道哪里冒出来的死丫头，她竟然穿着少帅的衣服！！
看这身板根本就是毛都没长齐的嫩芽儿！
要身材没身材，要脸蛋没脸蛋，难道少帅好这口？
不！不可能！
那么多男人拜倒在她石榴裙下，她对自己的魅力有足够自信！
云曦微微抬眸，站在这样气场强大的男人面前，即便撞破人家好事，也没有露出一丝怯意和尴尬。

慕非池锐利的寒眸紧紧的凝着她，压在喉中的火热，却被这柔嫩精致的脸蛋撩拨得一下子爆开！
他终于意识到不对劲！
猛地转头看了眼地板上摔碎的杯子，幽沉的眸底闪着森森寒意。
“你给我下药？！你找死！”
慕非池俊脸愠怒，一掀桌布，满茶几的茶杯茶盘全飞到了韩婉灵身上。
韩婉灵躲闪不及，被砸得眼冒金星。
“我……少帅，我、我不知道你在说什么？”
被他这么看瞪着，她有种瞬间被看穿的窘迫，低着头躲闪着他慑人的眸光。
云曦这才看向站在他身后的女人，看清了那张脸，心中倏然一跳！
这不就是韩耀天的姐姐韩婉灵吗？
她喊这个男人少帅……
云曦转开眸打量眼前的男人，俊美凌厉的侧面线条，像刀锋一般，神情中透着生人勿进的冰冷。

content_en:
Sitting up suddenly, she glanced around cautiously.
I was a little relieved when I found that there were no people or beasts.
Turning on the headlights, the whole room became brighter.
This is a very military-style room.
There is a dark green camouflage carpet, a large wooden bed with gray-green sheets, an office desk directly in front of it, and the walls are covered with military command charts.
The room is very spacious, with two completely different decoration styles.
You can work and rest at the same time without interfering with each other, becoming two independent spaces.
She thought of the man who got off the helicopter for no reason.
Although I couldn't see clearly what he looked like, with his imposing aura, I guessed he was a soldier.
Stopping talking, she looked down at the men's T-shirt she was wearing that was worn as a skirt.
The scratches on his arms, shoulders and legs were covered with medicine and wrapped with a layer of gauze, making him look like a mummy, which was a bit funny.
Open the door and go downstairs.
As soon as I reached the stairs, I heard a "crash" sound of glass breaking from downstairs.
"Get out!" The man's deep and cold voice broke the tranquility of the living room.
Standing on the stairs, Yun Xi glanced at the two figures of a man and a woman in the living room.
The man facing him by the floor-to-ceiling window was wearing a camouflage uniform and military boots, with a tall and arrogant figure with slender legs.
Even though his back was turned to her, Yun Xi could feel the powerful aura he was exuding at this moment.
"Young Marshal, please don't drive me away. There is no return train at this late hour. I am a girl who is scared..."
As soon as Han Wanling reached out to touch his strong and strong arm, Mu Feichi swiped her away, and the soldier's strength directly threw Han Wanling to the floor.
"Ah..." Unprepared to prevent herself from falling to the ground, Han Wanling pressed her hands directly on the broken glass on the floor, causing her to tremble in pain.
Mu Feichi turned around and frowned in disgust.
His slender hands unbuttoned the touched camouflage jacket and hit Han Wanling on the head.
There was a surge of heat in my body for no reason.
He lowered his eyes and caught a glimpse of the fallen woman on the floor, not forgetting the woman who was twisting her waist and crossing her legs to pretend to be aggrieved.
The hot red short skirt was lifted up, revealing the black lace panties underneath.
Mu Feichi's deep eyes were filled with unfathomable darkness. With just one glance, Han Wanling felt like she was being sharpened.
It was as if an invisible hand was strangling his throat, and he felt suffocated and depressed. How could he remember to take the opportunity to seduce him.
Yun Xi finally understood what was going on.
When he turned around and was about to walk back, a slight sound alerted the observant man in the living room.
"Stop!"
Yun Xi froze and retracted her feet that she had just stepped upstairs.
"Come down!"
Yun Xi turned around and walked down obediently under Mu Feichi's frightening eyes.
Han Wanling didn't seem to expect that there was anyone in the room, so she turned around and took a look.
This damn girl appeared out of nowhere, and she was wearing the clothes of a young commander! !
Look at this body, it’s just like a bud with no hair on it!
He has a body but not a figure, he has a face but not a cheek. Is it possible that the young commander is good at this?
No! impossible!
So many men fall under her pomegranate skirt, she is confident enough in her charm!
Yun Xi raised her eyes slightly, standing in front of such a powerful man, she didn't show a trace of timidity or embarrassment even if she ruined his good deeds.
Mu Feichi's sharp cold eyes stared at her tightly, and the heat in his throat suddenly exploded due to the tender and delicate face!
He finally realized something was wrong!
He suddenly turned his head and glanced at the broken cup on the floor, his deep eyes flashing with coldness.
"You drugged me?! You're looking for death!"
Mu Feichi's handsome face was sullen. He lifted the tablecloth and all the cups and trays on the coffee table flew to Han Wanling.
Han Wanling was unable to dodge and was hit so hard that stars appeared in her eyes.
"I... Young Marshal, I, I don't know what you are talking about?"
Being stared at by him like this, she felt embarrassed as if she had been seen through instantly., lowering his head to avoid his intimidating gaze.
Yun Xi then looked at the woman standing behind him, saw her face clearly, and her heart skipped a beat!
Isn't this Han Yaotian's sister Han Wanling?
She called this man Young Marshal...
Yun Xi turned her eyes to look at the man in front of her. His handsome and sharp profile was like a blade, and his expression was as cold as a stranger.
